landing.why.copy: Üretken yapay zeka hızlıdır, ancak temel olarak doğrulanmamıştır. Kurumsal uyumda, tahmin etmek bir sorumluluktur. AssureProof AI, modelleriniz ve çıktınız arasına deterministik bir doğrulama motoru yerleştirir. Matematiksel işlemleri resmi mantıkla kontrol eder, kaynak takibini tam sayfaya kadar yapar ve bir insan iki kez bakmak zorunda kalmadan her mantıksal boşluğu işaretler.

pipeline.1.name: Ingest Your File Stack
pipeline.1.line: Upload contracts, invoices, claims, or regulatory filings in any format. Every document stays isolated inside your environment.
pipeline.2.name: Page-Pinned Extraction (ParSure)
pipeline.2.line: Extracts every figure, obligation, and cross-reference—linking each data point directly to the exact page and line it came from.
pipeline.3.name: Structured Drafting (DraftSure)
pipeline.3.line: Generates reports, summaries, or approval memos built strictly from verified source facts, with zero ungrounded claims.
pipeline.4.name: Mathematical Consistency Check (Z3 Solver)
pipeline.4.line: Our formal logic engine tests whether every number and clause across all files can be true at the same time. If two facts conflict, export is automatically locked.
pipeline.5.name: Optional Adversarial Stress-Test (Red Hat Review)
pipeline.5.line: Trigger a separate, independent audit pass to hunt for edge-case ambiguities, missing attachments, or hidden compliance risks.
pipeline.6.name: Human Sign-Off & Audit Trail
pipeline.6.line: No document moves forward silently. An authorized reviewer resolves the conflict—or logs a formal override—before downloading the final file.

about.checks.1: AssureProof reads every document and keeps each figure tied to its source page. A language model then writes the draft. A formal consistency checker then tests whether the draft's figures and the values locked from the source can all be true at the same time. For a labeled figure, the language model does not make that call. For a sentence with no label, the language model turns it into a numeric comparison, and the formal consistency checker tests whether it holds. When a file is first read, the formal consistency checker can also flag figures in that file that contradict each other.
about.checks.2: Red-Hat review is separate, and it runs only when someone asks for it. A language model reads the draft the way a skeptical reviewer would and tries to find what is wrong: a mismatch with the attached source sentence, an overstatement, a missing clause, or a figure that needs a citation. It does not decide the numeric conflict. The review screen shows the contradiction and export is flagged. A person accepts or rejects each finding. The file can still be downloaded.

security.sub: Your most sensitive contracts, claims, and regulatory filings never have to touch a third-party cloud. AssureProof deploys directly inside your perimeter so your security team retains 100% custody of both documents and models.
security.pillar1.title: Self-Hosted & Air-Gapped Ready
security.pillar1.desc: Deploy inside your own AWS VPC, private GPU cluster, or on-premises data center. When running local models, zero bytes ever leave your network boundary.
security.pillar2.title: Zero Model Training or Retention
security.pillar2.desc: Your documents are never logged, pooled, or used to train external foundation models. Every session executes in an isolated environment under your existing IAM and encryption keys (BYOK).
security.pillar3.title: Immutable Governance & Audit Logs
security.pillar3.desc: Every extracted figure, flagged contradiction, reviewer sign-off, and manual override is cryptographically timestamped—giving internal auditors and regulators a complete chain of custody.
